title: Abbott wants legislators to turn data center restrictions into law next year
key_facts: Abbott said Wednesday 14 Oct 2026 he wants the Legislature to put his data center restrictions into law next year.
He rejects Democratic challenger Gina Hinojosa's push for quicker action before lawmakers return in January.
His guidelines: data centers pay for electrical infrastructure, use water-efficient cooling, report power and water use, limit noise; end sales tax breaks.
Last month Abbott ordered state regulators to halt data center permits while grid and water effects are reviewed.
Hinojosa said Tuesday: 'Abbott's moratorium on data centers is just words.'
Early voting begins Monday ahead of the 3 Nov election.
quote_evidence: "We have to make sure that we turn my guidelines into law, and then we can figure out what the pathway forward is going to be," Abbott said.
"Abbott's moratorium on data centers is just words," Hinojosa said.
why_it_matters_hint: A governor's data center limits may become law.
